## Problem and outcome

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting user or system behavior.

## Validation

List the automated and manual checks performed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The branch contains only the agreed feature and necessary supporting work.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Responsive and accessibility checks were completed where applicable.
- [ ] API validation, authentication, and ownership checks are present where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, `.env` files, connection strings, or personal data were committed.
- [ ] `docs/progress-status.md` reflects the delivered behavior and validation.
- [ ] Material decisions are recorded in `docs/decisions/`, or no decision record was needed.

## Follow-up

Record known limitations or remaining work. Write `None` when there is no follow-up.
